summary: community.clickhouse clickhouse_user deprecates password and type_password in favor of authentication, removed in 3.0.0.
questions: How should I set ClickHouse user passwords with Ansible?

answer_card.title: clickhouse_user password deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: In `clickhouse_user`, `password` and `type_password` are deprecated and removed in community.clickhouse 3.0.0. Use **`authentication`**.
